journeys.journey: New User Onboarding to First Booking
journeys.purpose: Guide a new user from app install to completing their first service booking
steps: Onboarding: introduce app value and AURA
Authentication: sign up or log in
Home: browse featured providers
Search: optionally search for specific service
Provider Selection: choose a provider
Service Selection: select desired service(s)
Booking: pick date, time, location
Payment: enter payment details and confirm
Confirmation: view booking confirmation
journeys.success: Booking confirmation screen with QR code
journeys.failure: Any step fails validation or network
journeys.recovery: Retry specific step, use cached data, offline fallbacks
journeys.exit: Home screen with active booking tab

journeys.purpose: Discover, evaluate, and purchase a beauty product
journeys.trigger: Browsing home or seeing product recommendation
steps: Store: browse product grid
Search: optionally search for product
Filter: apply category, price, rating filters
Product Detail: view product images, description, reviews
Add to Cart: select quantity
Cart Review: verify items and totals
Checkout: enter shipping and payment details
Payment: complete transaction via Wompi
Confirmation: view order confirmation
journeys.failure: Network error, payment declined, validation error
journeys.recovery: Retry payment, fix validation, clear cart and restart
journeys.exit: Home screen or profile orders tab

journeys.purpose: Get AI beauty analysis and apply recommendations to book service or buy product
journeys.trigger: From Ideas tab or provider detail capture button
steps: AURA Welcome: learn about analysis
Capture: take selfie or upload image
Processing: show analysis in progress
Results: view analysis report and confidence scores
Recommendations: see suggested services and products
Apply: book recommended service or add product to cart
Booking/Payment: complete transaction as per respective journeys
decision_points: Proceed to booking or store flow
journeys.success: Analysis completed and recommendation acted upon
journeys.failure: Capture failed, analysis error, network timeout
journeys.recovery: Retry capture, check connection, use fallback analysis
journeys.exit: Booking confirmation or order confirmation screen

global_navigation.description: Bottom navigation bar for primary app sections
global_navigation.controller: UI Component Language (S4) + AudienceService for adaptive colors

contextual_navigation.description: App bar and drawer for screen-level actions
contextual_navigation.controller: UI Component Language (S4) + individual screen logic
patterns: App Bar with back button and actions
Tabs for content filtering (in Academy, Course detail)
Segmented control (via ChoiceChip in some screens)

back_navigation.description: System back button and explicit back arrows in AppBar
back_navigation.controller: Framework (Navigator) + UI Component Language for AppBar variants

deep_links.description: Routes defined in main.dart for direct screen access

redirects.description: Automatic navigation after auth or onboarding completion
examples: After successful login: go to intended route or home
After onboarding completion: go to AURA welcome or home
After email verification: go to login

modal_flows.description: Bottom sheets, dialogs, and full-screen sheets for transient tasks
examples: Location picker - bottom sheet or full screen
Date picker - dialog or full screen
Terms and conditions - full screen sheet

bottom_sheets.description: Used for actions that require context from underlying screen

dialogs.description: Used for critical decisions or information display

tabs.description: Used for content filtering within a screen

nested_navigation.description: Limited to specific flows like provider dashboard with tabs
examples: Provider dashboard with tabs for services, appointments, earnings

Loading.description: Content is being fetched or processed
Loading.handling: Skeleton loaders or spinners matching component layout, no layout shift

Empty.handling: Proprietary illustration + headline + body + primary CTA, never "No data" alone

Success.handling: Success color (S1) + GlowIcon.check, toast or inline message

Error.handling: Error color (S1) + GlowIcon.alert, inline for field errors, banner for form/toast, full screen for critical

Unavailable.handling: Disabled state or specific unavailable UI with guidance

Pending.handling: Processing state UI, often with spinner or progress indicator

Processing.handling: AURA-specific loading (expanding rings) or standard spinner

Cancelled.handling: Return to previous state with cancellation confirmation

Expired.description: Time-sensitive data or session no longer valid
Expired.handling: Redirect to renewal or login with expired notice

Offline.handling: Offline banner or full screen with retry option, cached data where available

Permission denied.handling: Explain permission need and provide system settings link

Authentication required.description: User must log in to access feature
Authentication required.handling: Redirect to login screen with return URL

accessibility.semantic_labels: PARTIAL - icon-only controls need semantic labels (e.g., chat button, back button)
accessibility.tooltips: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no tooltip system found
accessibility.contrast: PARTIAL - primary text verified (12.8:1 Women, ~4.2:1 Men target); CTA on brand requires validation; Aura Teal light 8.2:1; Aura Teal dark fails 1.8:1 (documented exception)
accessibility.focus: PARTIAL - 2px Focus Border (S1) required on ALL interactive; buttons lack visible focus on web
accessibility.keyboard: REQUIRES_IMPLEMENTATION - Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter/Space activate, Escape dismiss, focus trap for modals/sheets
accessibility.screen_reader: REQUIRES_IMPLEMENTATION - semantic labels on icon-only controls, live regions for loading/errors/toasts, S2 heading hierarchy
